description: Sets up a codebase for coding agents, or measures an existing one and cleans it up step by step.

comment_review.title: Comment review

steering_gate.description: Write CODEOWNERS and the ruleset bootstrap so a human must approve every change to a steering file. Blocks only on a Team or public repo.
